rationale: The agent identified the user and fetched several orders, then executed a return/refund via return_delivered_order_items for one item on order #W3916020. However, it did not visibly authenticate the user beyond internal lookups, and more critically, it performed an order-changing write without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. The agent also failed to provide final, clear information about the return/refund (e.g., confirmation details, timelines, or that funds will go to the original credit card), ending only with a generic thank-you. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
